subject.title: fix(kill-tree): verify process group leader before using group kill to prevent gateway SIGTERM (#76259)

question: Should OpenClaw accept leader-verified group kill as the default for omitted-`detached` Unix cleanup and land this fix after rebase/CI refresh?
rationale: The code path fixes a real gateway-termination bug, but it deliberately changes shared process-cleanup semantics for callers that omit `detached`, which is compatibility- and availability-sensitive.

options.title: Accept Guarded Default
options.body: Land the leader-check approach after refreshing against current main and verifying CI, accepting direct-pid fallback when a PID cannot be verified as a group leader.

options.title: Require More Caller State
options.body: Ask for a rebase plus any additional current-main detached cleanup surfaces to pass explicit `detached: true` before merge.

options.title: Pause For Broader Process Cleanup
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want a larger process-lifecycle redesign rather than changing the shared helper default now.

recommendation.title: Accept Guarded Default
recommendation.body: Land the leader-check approach after refreshing against current main and verifying CI, accepting direct-pid fallback when a PID cannot be verified as a group leader.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main process/helper ownership and listed Agents/Security area make this the best available routing owner for the compatibility decision.
